title: How to Play
subtitle: This is how Picks4All works — from prediction to podium
description: Discover how the platform works step by step. From making your prediction to watching live results and competing on the leaderboard.

prediction.title: 1. Make your prediction
prediction.description: Before each match, predict the final score. Select goals for each team and save your prediction before the deadline.
prediction.note: The deadline is set when creating the pool (e.g., 10 minutes before kickoff).

liveResults.title: 2. Live results
liveResults.description: During the match, scores update automatically. You can watch the progress live directly in your pool.

scoring.title: 3. How your points are calculated
scoring.description: After each match, the system automatically calculates your points by comparing your prediction with the actual result.

leaderboard.title: 4. Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Compete against all players in your pool. The leaderboard updates in real time after every match.

allMatches.title: 5. Play in ALL matches
allMatches.description: It's not just one match — you can predict in every match of the tournament, from the group stage to the final.

winners.title: 6. The winners
winners.description: At the end of the tournament, the players with the most accumulated points win. Will you be the best predictor?

cta.title: Ready to play?
cta.subtitle: Create your pool for free and start making your predictions.
